tools.name: get_framework_info
tools.description: Version, scale, overlays, owner roles, lifecycle stages, the cross-referenced standards and how to cite AACF. Call this first.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Every domain with its summary and the ID and title of each control in it.

tools.name: get_control
tools.description: One control in full: objective, rationale, level descriptors 1 to 5, Level 3 criteria (with the overlays they apply to), questions, evidence, guidance, owners, dependencies and cross-references.

tools.name: search_controls
tools.description: Find controls by words in their title, objective, rationale, criteria or questions, optionally filtered by domain, overlay, owner role or lifecycle stage. Returns summaries; use get_control for detail.

tools.name: get_mapping
tools.description: Reverse lookup: the controls that address an item of a standard, with strength (direct or partial) and confidence. A ref that is a prefix (for example 6.1) returns every item under it.

tools.name: get_standard_coverage
tools.description: Every cross-referenced item of one standard, the controls covering each, and summary counts.

tools.name: get_assessment_questions
tools.description: Questions, evidence and the applicable Level 3 criteria for one domain (or a published profile), for a self-assessment the user's own assistant runs. Pass the overlays that apply to the organisation. Answers are never sent to this server. Call with no domain to list the domains.

tools.name: get_scoring_rules
tools.description: The assessor rulebook: scope, statuses, how to place a level (Level 3 needs every applicable criterion met; never round up), evidence, targets and how to report.
